articles.headline: England's Harry Kane: 'I feel as good as I've ever felt going onto the pitch'
articles.description: England captain Harry Kane has said he feels as good he has ever felt in his career as he looks to extend his remarkable season.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Travel chaos sees Speed miss Ronaldo game; Messi in action
articles.description: It's the final day of the round of 32 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup as we decide the final three spots for the round of 16.

articles.headline: Jordan Ayew takes centre stage as Ghana end 16-year wait for another World Cup knockout game
articles.description: For almost his entire international career, Jordan Ayew has lived in the shadow of Ghana's greatest FIFA World Cup generation. Now it's his chance to shine.

articles.headline: Coach Carlos Queiroz targeting sixth FIFA World Cup in 2030... with Ghana?
articles.description: Ghana head coach Carlos Queiroz appears to have opened the door to extending his stay with the Black Stars, with the 73-year-old setting his sights on a record-equalling sixth FIFA World Cup appearance in four years.

articles.headline: How a plucky club "with a dry pitch" moulded Thomas Tuchel into England's ideal boss
articles.description: ESPN's Tom Hamilton spoke to figures from Thomas Tuchel's past who witnessed his rise to become England's ideal boss.

articles.headline: Julian Nagelsmann out as Germany boss, Jürgen Klopp lined up as replacement
articles.description: Julian Nagelsmann is out as the Germany head coach following the team's shock exit from the World Cup in the round of 32, with talks already being sought with Jürgen Klopp to replace him.
